Dirk Combat Jacket.name: Veste de combat Surineuse
Dirk Combat Jacket.description: Leisurewear-styled Light Armorjack and the ability to conceal two standard magazines without a check.

Executive Armor.name: Armure corporatiste
Executive Armor.description: Light Armorjack that looks like businesswear. Restores 1SP every day SP isn't lost on the armor.

Fire Brand Bunker Gear.name: Tenue de protection ignifugée Fire Brand
Fire Brand Bunker Gear.description: Fireproof flak armor with a built in gas mask and oxygen tank. -4 to REF, DEX, and MOVE.

Laser Light Street Jacket.name: Veste urbaine Laser Light
Laser Light Street Jacket.description:
An armored Urban Flash Jacket that counts as a Light Tattoo while worn.

+2 to Wardrobe & Style if you have at least two Light Tattoos installed

Lotos Netsuit.name: Combinaison CitiNet Lotos
Lotos Netsuit.description:
A netsuit allowing an extra cyberdeck hardware slot that's installed directly into the suit which is uninstalled if the suit is removed. Comes standard with an Excellent Quality Cyberdeck*. -2 to REF, DEX, and MOVE.

*Must be manually added after acquiring the armor

Masetto AirRider.name: AirRider Masetto
Masetto AirRider.description: Kevlar Body Armor that ignores the Whiplash critical injury from car crashes as long as the armor's CO2 tank is full.

MechaMan Motorcycle Helmet.name: Casque de moto MechaMan
MechaMan Motorcycle Helmet.description: A Kevlar motorcycle helmet with integrated smart glasses that come with Chyron and Low Light / IR / UV pre-installed.

Montage Variable Clothing.name: Montage Variable Clothing
Montage Variable Clothing.description:
Light Armorjack that can swap between pre-programmed patterns and styles via a connected @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_upgrades.Item.pDQRjH8q63YyoWSp]{App}

Comes with your choice of 3 pre-programmed patterns or colors selected from either @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_upgrades.Item.Rs94jDJRrbHVpvIh]{Gang Colors} or @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_upgrades.Item.7fXDqCH4Z3ZLo5kL]{Generic Chic} styles.

Requires an action to swap styles via connected agent.

Shock Armor.name: Armure taser
Shock Armor.description:
Kevlar armor designed for prison use.

Use an action on your turn during a grapple to shock the attacker. The grapple ends immediately on a failed DV15 Resist Torture/Dugs Check.

Skid Row Trench.name: Trench-coat SkidRow
Skid Row Trench.description: Flak Body Armor that looks like a trench coat in exchange for less protection. -4 to REF, DEX, and MOVE.

Street Viper Riding Suit.name: Combinaison de moto Street Viper
Street Viper Riding Suit.description: Kevlar Body Armor that comes with two pre-installed Viper Blades.

Tactical Smart Armor.description: A full set of medium armorjack with integrated smart glasses. -2 to REF, DEX, and MOVE.
